card.text: A Cepheid in the Andromeda Galaxy, 761 kiloparsecs away, that swells and shrinks every 19.6 days.

introduction.text: The Hubble Space Telescope measured its brightness in three colours and its pulsation of 19.6 days. Its galaxy's distance, 761 kiloparsecs, was measured from Cepheids like it.

color.title: Colour
color.summary: The colour of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
